sql_templates.description: Fetches the latest events for today with sector and technical context
sql_templates.template:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (ce.symbol) ce.symbol, ce.event_date, ce.event_type, ra.industry, sn.stage, sn.trading_signal
FROM signals.corporate_events ce
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots sn ON ce.symbol = sn.symbol
JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON ce.symbol = ra.symbol
WHERE ce.event_date = CURRENT_DATE
AND sn.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ra.period_end = (SELECT MAX(period_end) FROM scores.results_analysis)
ORDER BY ce.symbol, ce.event_date DESC, ra.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

sql_templates.description: Collect signal outcomes with the latest stage and EOD price.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_signals AS (
    SELECT * FROM signals.signal_log
    WHERE date_issued = (SELECT MAX(date_issued) FROM signals.signal_log)
),
latest_stages AS (
    SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_eod AS (
    SELECT * FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
)
SELECT s.symbol, s.signal, s.hit_target, s.hit_stop
FROM latest_signals s
JOIN latest_stages st ON s.symbol = st.symbol
JOIN latest_eod e ON s.symbol = e.symbol
LIMIT 100;
